diagnosis: Job EXP-40233 exceeds the six-hour stall threshold per kb-0005. The 6 GB export in eu-central has stalled and must be cancelled and resubmitted. No region-service mismatch applies here since data_export is entitled in eu-central.
reply: I understand your export job EXP-40233 in eu-central has been running for about seven hours. According to our documentation, export jobs under 10 GB usually complete within an hour, and any job running more than six hours has stalled. As a next step, please cancel EXP-40233 and resubmit the export. If you continue to see delays after resubmission, let us know and we will investigate further.
